note: USACE Louisville District campground on Green River Lake north-east of Columbia, its loops on a wooded point; the D loop runs along the east shore through trees above the lake. Now run by volunteers with limited tollhouse hours (recreation.gov notice, read 2026-11-24). Playground and interpretive trail in the campground; the marina-run swim beach, boat ramp and fishing pier are within a mile, and multi-use trails (horses allowed) are just down the road. --Claude
summary: Kept. $20 non-electric / $26 electric / $32 water+electric (2026-27); 123 public sites (125 incl. 2 hosts), 50A, water at 62, max 99 ft, 11 pull-throughs; flush toilets, showers, dump; season ~Apr 17-Oct 24 (2027 rates Apr 16-Oct 23); rec.gov only (reserve before setting up), 14-night max, 3-night holiday minimum. Not waterfront kept. Now volunteer-run.
